phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase B — F2M component materialization
purpose: Materialize the empirically supported deposits-only F2M holder-by-issuer component as a separate accounting artifact while preserving total F2 as unresolved until F21 currency is independently identified.

classification.OBSERVED: A 2025-Q4 stock cell produced by one exact usable QSA series with no sector aggregation or complement calculation.
classification.DERIVED: An exact transformation only: F=S12-S121; annual flow=sum of Q1-Q4 transactions; and/or a resident-holder→X unique complement to a published W0 holder total after every resident issuer cell is resolved, with independent aggregate controls passed.
classification.NOT_APPLICABLE: A structural non-issuer H/C column for deposits or the X→X cell outside the Romanian national financial-accounts boundary. This is not an observed numeric zero.

rounding.component_value: round to two decimals, matching the declared ECB published precision used by the accounting materialization layer
rounding.audit_calculation: retain full parsed precision inside the source audit artifact

required_offline_checks: retained workflow artifact SHA-256 matches the A2 assessment digest
A1 report contains exactly 72 stock/flow matrix cells
all A1 series keys referenced by cells and aggregate controls map to retained raw payloads
all A2 aggregate-series raw payload SHA-256 values match the retained bytes
all required A2 identity controls pass for stock and flow
all five resident-holder→X stock and flow values reproduce their unique row complements
the materialized stock matrix contains 10 OBSERVED, 13 DERIVED and 13 NOT_APPLICABLE cells
the materialized 2025 flow matrix contains 23 DERIVED and 13 NOT_APPLICABLE cells
materialized holder and issuer controls remain within 0.1 million RON after published-precision rounding
total F2 is not modified or claimed complete
promotion_rule: A passing materialization creates only model/accounting/f2m_component_2025.json and its manifest/registry metadata. The canonical model/accounting/benchmark_2025.json F2 matrix remains unchanged and incomplete until F21 currency and any remaining total-F2 definition bridge pass separate gates.
